=== registers by name
	.text
f:
	.cfi_startproc
	mflr 0
	stwu 1, -32(1)
	.cfi_def_cfa_offset 32
	.cfi_register lr, r0
	stw 31, 28(1)
	stw 0, 36(1)
	.cfi_offset lr, 4
	.cfi_offset r31, -4
	.cfi_offset %r30, -8
	.cfi_offset f14, -16
	.cfi_offset v20, -24
	.cfi_offset cr2, -28
	.cfi_same_value ctr
	mr 31, 1
	.cfi_def_cfa_register r31
	lwz 0, 36(1)
	lwz 31, 28(1)
	mtlr 0
	addi 1, 1, 32
	.cfi_def_cfa r1, 0
	.cfi_restore lr
	.cfi_restore r31
	blr
	.cfi_endproc
=== lines counted in instructions
	.file 1 "a.c"
	.text
f:
	.loc 1 3 0
	li 3, 0
	.loc 1 4 5
	.skip 400
	li 3, 1
	.loc 1 5 1
	blr
=== a prefixed instruction padded off a 64-byte boundary | -g
	.text
	.fill 15, 4, 0x60000000
lab:
	paddi 3, 4, 100, 0
	b lab
	.fill 14, 4, 0x60000000
lab3:	pli 3, 2
	xxlor 33, 34, 35
	b lab3
=== a .loc on a padded prefixed instruction
	.file 1 "a.c"
	.text
	.fill 15, 4, 0x60000000
	.loc 1 5
	pli 3, 1
	.loc 1 6
	vaddubm 2, 3, 4
